title: StateHash uses a fixed 4096-byte buffer; oversized states silently hash to the FNV offset basis
detail: Any state serializing past 4096 bytes (≈83 packets at 48 bytes each, plus topology/log) makes SerializeState return 0; StateHash then hashes zero bytes, so every oversized state yields the identical FNV offset basis. Replay-equality silently false-passes with no error.
recommended_fix: Grow the buffer until serialization succeeds (or add a vector-based SerializeState overload); treat N==0 from SerializeState as a hard failure in StateHash — never hash zero bytes.

title: StepScenario silently drops replay commands beyond 16 per tick
detail: Commands beyond 16 sharing an apply_tick are silently dropped — no latch, no log. ApplyEdit can append unbounded same-tick entries, so a 17th edit between two ticks vanishes on replay, diverging live vs replay undetected.
recommended_fix: Drop the fixed cap: collect the tick's entries into a std::vector<FCommand>, or clamp loudly and latch ReplayError on overflow — never discard logged commands silently.

title: Same-tick re-step is unguarded and double-spawns demand packets
detail: The guard rejects only Tick < State.Tick; calling Step(S, T) twice re-runs the tick: demand entries with Tick==T spawn duplicate packets and score counts twice, silently — no latch, unlike backward ticks.
recommended_fix: Gate spawns on a last-spawned-tick watermark (or reject Tick <= State.Tick re-execution) and latch ReplayError on same-tick re-steps so the divergence is observable.

title: Golden probe printf hardcodes nodes=3, pipes=2, spawned=11 — tautological keys with zero drift detection
detail: nodes, pipes, and spawned are literal constants while every other key is computed from state; compare-golden.sh then enforces hardcode-vs-hardcode — a tautology that cannot detect fixture or spawn drift, the exact false-green gates exist to prevent.
recommended_fix: Compute the keys: NodeCount(State.Topology), PipeCount(State.Topology); add a spawned counter to FFlowState (or derive from NextPacketId) instead of the literal 11.

title: Seed-divergence and non-vacuous-heartbeat conformance checks deleted without replacement
detail: The rewrite removes both pinned sensitivity checks and replaces them only with a demand-plan divergence check; seed-sensitivity and heartbeat non-vacuity are no longer asserted anywhere in the conformance runner.
recommended_fix: Re-add both against the scenario: run BuildProbeScenario with seed 43 and assert StateHash divergence; assert StateHash changes across at least one step boundary.

title: ApplyEdit (the live fast-path) is never exercised by any test in the diff
detail: ApplyEdit — the live path and the source of every action-log entry — is invoked by no test in this diff; the E10 claim that live and replay see identical state at every step boundary has zero coverage.
recommended_fix: Add a dual-run test: apply the draws via ApplyEdit (live) in one run and via the logged replay in another, then assert identical StateHash at every step boundary.

title: EqualCostHops claims stale-table detection but FRoutingTable carries no generation
detail: The comment promises ok=false on a stale table, but the table stores only HopOffset/HopCount/Hops/N — no gen. A topology change that keeps node count (any draw) leaves a stale table reporting fresh routes with ok=true.
recommended_fix: Store the built-for Topology.Gen in FRoutingTable and compare it in EqualCostHops, or delete the stale-detection claim from the comment.

title: Serve-pass comment describes repeating windows; the code is a single FIFO pass
detail: "Windows repeat until the bundle's capacity is consumed or nothing is ready" describes no code in the diff — the serve pass is one linear FIFO sweep per bundle with no repeat loop. Leftover design prose misdescribes the algorithm.
recommended_fix: Rewrite the comment to describe the actual single work-conserving pass, or implement the round loop if repeating windows were intended.

title: Versioned save format has no deserializer and no parse-back test
detail: "Readers reject older versions" cites readers that exist nowhere in the diff, and the round-trip test only compares two serializations of the same state — it cannot catch field-order or layout mistakes on parse.
recommended_fix: Add DeserializeState (rejecting wrong magic/version) plus a parse-back-equality test, or drop the reader language and label the format hash-only.
